description: This file defines the MediaCodecWrapper class, which simplifies the interaction with Android's MediaCodec API for encoding and decoding media streams. It manages buffers, callbacks, and provides factory methods for creating codecs based on media formats.

classes.name: MediaCodecWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class around Android's MediaCodec to facilitate buffer management, callback handling, and media sample processing for decoding media streams.

classes.name: MediaCodecWrapper.OutputFormatChangedListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to output format change events.

classes.name: MediaCodecWrapper.OutputSampleListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to output sample (frame) events.

methods.name: stopAndRelease
methods.description: Stops and releases the media codec, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: setOutputFormatChangedListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for output format changes, with optional handler for callback threading.

methods.name: fromVideoFormat
methods.description: Factory method to create a MediaCodecWrapper instance configured for a specific video MediaFormat and surface.

methods.name: writeSample
methods.description: Enqueues a media sample buffer into the decoder for processing.

methods.name: writeSample (MediaExtractor)
methods.description: Enqueues a media sample obtained from MediaExtractor into the decoder, handling secure and non-secure samples.

methods.name: peekSample
methods.description: Peeks at the next output buffer info to be processed or rendered.

methods.name: popSample
methods.description: Releases and optionally renders the next output buffer, notifying the output sample listener.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Synchronizes the internal buffer queues with the current state of the codec, detecting format changes and buffer changes.
